summary: Verified Cloudinary -> PostMePlex (Emergent object storage) migration end-to-end on the web surface. All 8 backend pytest cases passed (upload shape, auth-required, empty-reject, full fetch 200, Range 206, missing 404, default avatar 200, create post with uploaded image). Web UI E2E: logged a scratch test_* user, composed a text+image post via PostComposer. Network capture confirmed POST /api/upload returned {url, secure_url, path, bytes, content_type} with url=https://<BACKEND>/api/files/postmeplex/uploads/<user_id>/<hex>.png (bytes=72, content_type=image/png) and POST /api/posts persisted image_url pointing to /api/files (NOT res.cloudinary.com). Composer preview and feed post both rendered via /api/files/postmeplex/uploads/.... Default avatar served from /api/files/postmeplex/branding/default_avatar.png (HTTP 200) and is used as the author avatar for the new user. No AI/LLM/TTS endpoints were exercised (credit-sensitive constraint respected).
action_items: Optional: /app/backend/.env still has CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME=dpnrol54k and CLOUDINARY_UPLOAD_PRESET=ml_default, and /app/frontend/.env still has REACT_APP_CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME and REACT_APP_CLOUDINARY_UPLOAD_PRESET. These are now dead config since storage.py no longer uses them and frontend/src/lib/cloudinary.js posts to /api/upload. Safe to remove to prevent confusion.

Optional: DEFAULT_AVATAR_URL in /app/backend/.env still points to the disabled Cloudinary URL (https://res.cloudinary.com/dpnrol54k/image/upload/v1790317297/postmeplex_icon_v2.png). server.py already overrides this at startup (lines 63-65) when it detects 'res.cloudinary.com/dpnrol54k', so no functional impact, but recommend clearing the env value or replacing with the /api/files URL for clarity.

Historical/seed data still references Cloudinary (res.cloudinary.com/dpnrol54k/image/upload/sample.jpg, blob_cpgjgj.jpg, demo video thumbs in server.py lines 2729, 2917-2928). User explicitly acknowledged 'Old Cloudinary media is accepted as lost'; these will 401. If desired, main agent can re-upload stock seeds to PostMePlex storage or point seed URLs to the new /api/files path, but this is NOT blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: storage.py uses a module-level httpx.AsyncClient — fine for FastAPI's single event loop; it will leak on hot-reload but is acceptable.
serve_file() returns the full body plus a synthesized 206 when the upstream ignores a Range header — correct for iOS Safari video seeking.
/api/upload has NO explicit size cap on the server side (frontend caps at 1GB). Consider adding a server-side guard to prevent abusive large uploads.

/api/upload has NO content-type whitelist — any file type can be uploaded. If this is user-generated media, consider restricting to image/*, video/*, audio/* to reduce the attack surface (e.g. HTML with inline script served from the same origin as the SPA).
test_credentials: Used scratch user test_webui_<rand> registered via /api/auth/register (pin=1122). Founder credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md were available but not used to avoid credit-sensitive flows.
seed_data_creation: Registered scratch user test_webui_* and test_stor_* (auto-purged on backend restart per PRD). Created one post containing the uploaded 8x8 PNG.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The /api/upload + /api/files endpoints and the composer flow are fully migrated to PostMePlex storage. If the next task touches media again, the Cloudinary leftovers listed under action_items are the known cleanup items. No AI/LLM/TTS endpoints were exercised per credit-sensitive constraint.
